headline: Congress named the Department of Transportation headquarters building in Washington, DC, after two former transportation leaders, William T. Coleman, Jr. and Norman Y. Mineta.
what_it_does: The law renames the headquarters building of the Department of Transportation at 1200 New Jersey Avenue, SE, in Washington, DC. It will be called the William T. Coleman, Jr. and Norman Y. Mineta Federal Building. The law does not change the building's use, budget, or the duties of the department.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 6, 2022.
